evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.footer: Everything above was recorded by the browser adapter during this attempt. Highlighted rows are cited by the bug report. Nothing here is inferred.

reproduction.title: Reproduction
reproduction.compiledNote: Generated from the plan by the compiler and run with the standard Playwright runner, independently of the EXEGEZIS engine. A verified bug requires it to fail at the same step.
reproduction.nothingExecuted: Nothing was executed. The benchmark recorded {outcome} because {why}.
reproduction.runsBreakdown: {passes} passed · {timeouts} timed out · {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}
reproduction.criteriaTitle: Verification criteria (all six required for a verified bug)
reproduction.noReproductionFile: reproduction.json is not available for this result (archived results keep only the report).

criteria.anchored: An expectation anchored in a verified state
criteria.executable_test: A deterministic executable test that fails

rootCause.title: Root cause
rootCause.subtitle: root-cause investigation of {bug} · plan {plan}
rootCause.rule: A cause is only shown as validated when an intervention on an isolated copy removed the bug in every run and the competing hypotheses were refuted.

fix.title: Fix
fix.proposedNone: None (root-cause mutations are experiments, discarded after each run; they are not fixes)
fix.regressionExists: The compiled reproduction test ({path}) exists, but it has not been used as a regression test for any fix.

fixVerification.title: Fix verification
fixVerification.regressionNotRun: Not run: there is no fix.

notImplemented.notYet: EXEGEZIS does not produce this yet
notImplemented.requires: What this stage will require before anything appears here

plan.subtitle: {id} · {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}
plan.modelOnly: The model only wrote this plan. It did not see any run, and nothing it wrote is used as evidence: the verdict comes from the deterministic engine.
plan.declined: The planner declined to write a plan
plan.author: Author
plan.targetsChecked: {checked} target(s) checked against the live page, {unchecked} not checkable before running

claims.title: Investigation · claims
claims.subtitle: What is claimed, and on what basis
claims.noChain: No evidence chain: the report has no failing attempt to explain (no plan was executed).
claims.noChainOutcome: No evidence chain: the report has no failing attempt to explain ({outcome}).
claims.declaredNote: Declared in the plan: the behaviour the symptom says is broken, written as the correct behaviour.
claims.observedNote: Recorded by the engine during the attempt.

future.hypothesisDetail: A candidate cause, stated with an intervention and a prediction.
future.experimentDetail: The intervention applied to an isolated copy, reproduced against the baseline.
future.decisionDetail: Validated only if one hypothesis survives and its alternatives were refuted.

claims.whoModel: The model may only propose a plan: an expectation and the steps to test it.
claims.whoEngine: The engine records observations and derives the verdict from six deterministic criteria.
claims.whoCause: A cause is claimed only by the deterministic decision over intervention experiments. Nothing may yet claim a fix or that a fix works.
